name: SWIR XBookmark
title: 10.29 STABLE — SYMBOL SAFE NICKS + ACK ROUTE GUARD
nick_policy: Nickname punctuation is preserved as identity data. One final native CZATeria display delimiter is removed only while parsing the message-login DOM label.
friends_policy: Exact nickname identity is preserved through local Friends storage, UserData resolution, outgoing 8/4 username, incoming ACK, 159 snapshot keys and rooms panel lookup.
legacy_guard_policy: Friend packets from older background timers are blocked so they cannot race the current 8/4 and 85 flow.
route_policy: Code 85 uses the per-socket ACK Route Guard and avoids guessing when multiple fresh ACK candidates exist.
snapshot_policy: Fresh 159 snapshots are merged per connection with a 15-second TTL to reduce partial-snapshot loss.
rooms_policy: The Friends panel keeps simple labels and preserves exact nicknames, including punctuation.
mix_policy: MIX 8/8 is loaded from the frozen writing module.
ice_policy: 10.30 Beta layers an isolated readability guard over the 10.29 Stable base. In ICE it detects near-white message text and forces a readable dark foreground without changing nick colors or Friends/ACK/snapshot/MIX logic.
launcher_policy: Launcher shows exactly three Stable versions and three Beta versions. 10.29 is recommended Stable; 10.30 is the newest Beta.
